description: This file defines the RefreshTokenEntity class implementing OAuth2 refresh token logic for the OrangeHRM system. It manages refresh token identifiers, expiry times, and associated access tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 refresh token entity within the OrangeHRM system, managing token identifiers, expiry, and associated access tokens.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the refresh token's unique identifier.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the refresh token's unique identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the refresh token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the refresh token, overriding to UTC.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Associates an access token with this refresh token.
